items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Ed Cole was playing with Noble Sissle.

ctx.x: But it's -- it all points out to be a segregation sort of thing anyhow, you know, but the nightclub was downstairs, and the dance hall was upstairs. So you had bands like Lunceford and Chick Webb, and this is how I met Beverly Pier, Eubie Blake -- what was his partner's name?
Noble Sissle. Ed Cole was playing with Noble Sissle.
